title_en: Mingfa Group Co., Ltd. v. Baolong Group Development Co., Ltd. et al. — contract dispute
ruling_gist_en: Where the parties agree in a contract that disputes arising from the contract may be either submitted to a people's court for litigation or to an arbitration institution for arbitration, the parties' agreement on arbitration is invalid. However, if after a dispute arises, one party applies for arbitration to an arbitration institution and the other party does not raise an objection and actually participates in the arbitration, it shall be deemed that the parties have reached a consensus to resolve the dispute through arbitration. Thereafter, if either party initiates litigation in a people's court regarding the same contractual dispute, the people's court shall not accept the case; if already accepted, the court shall rule to dismiss the action.

full_text_en:
Mingfa Group Co., Ltd. v. Baolong Group Development Co., Ltd. et al. — dispute over contract

【Ruling Summary】

Where the parties agree in the contract that any dispute arising from the contract may be submitted either to a people's court for litigation or to an arbitration institution for arbitration, the arbitration agreement is invalid. However, if after a dispute arises, one party files an application for arbitration with an arbitration institution and the other party does not raise an objection and actually participates in the arbitration, it shall be deemed that the parties have reached a mutual agreement to resolve the dispute through arbitration. Thereafter, if either party files a lawsuit with a people's court concerning the same contract dispute, the people's court shall not accept the case; if the case has already been accepted, the court shall rule to dismiss the lawsuit.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

No. 480 (2021) Final Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): Mingfa Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at 30th Floor, Mingfa Building, No. 327 Qianpu Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Legal Representative: Huang Huanming, Chairman of the Company.

Appellee (Defendant at First Instance): Baolong Group Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 405, Phase II, Baolong Center, No. 307 Jiahe Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Legal Representative: Xu Jiankang, Chairman of the Company.

Third Party at First Instance: Grant Thornton Certified Public Accountants (Special General Partnership), Xiamen Branch, domiciled at Floors 12-15, Zone A, Innovation Building, Software Park, Xiamen Torch Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone.

Person in Charge: Liu Wei.

The appellant, Mingfa Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Mingfa Company), appealed against the civil ruling of the Fujian High People's Court in Case No. (2019) Min Chu 44 concerning a dispute over a contract with the appellee, Baolong Group Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baolong Company), and the third party at first instance, Grant Thornton Certified Public Accountants (Special General Partnership), Xiamen Branch. The appeal was filed with this Court. After the case was docketed on March 2, 2021, this Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to hear the case. The trial of this case has now been concluded.

Mingfa Company appealed with the following requests: to set aside the ruling of first instance and instruct the court of first instance to continue hearing the case. The main facts and reasons are as follows: 1. The dispute in this case is the first time Mingfa Company has raised relevant claims before a judicial authority, and it has not been adjudicated by a judicial authority. The court of first instance erred in refusing to accept the case. First, the Xiamen Arbitration Commission did not determine or handle the development costs and non-operating expenses amounting to RMB 572,359,122.72 involved in the "Report on Procedures Agreed to Be Performed for Expenditures of the Xiamen Mingfa Commercial Plaza Cooperation Project." Second, Mingfa Company's claims for brand usage fees, property usage fees, and other claims were neither included in the requests or counterclaims of the arbitration case nor adjudicated by any adjudicatory body, including the Xiamen Arbitration Commission. 2. Where the parties have not agreed to have the dispute submitted to an arbitration institution, Mingfa Company may resolve other disputes arising from the "Contract for the Cooperative Development of 'Mingfa Commercial Plaza'" (hereinafter referred to as the Cooperation Contract) through litigation. (a) Pursuant to Article 7 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Arbitration Law of the PRC, the arbitration clause in Article 12 of the Cooperation Contract is legally invalid and shall be deemed as the parties not having reached an agreement to submit to arbitration. (b) Mingfa Company's participation in the arbitration only indicates its consent to resolve the matters involved in the requests and counterclaims in the arbitration case through arbitration, and cannot be presumed to imply its consent to resolve other disputes under the contract through arbitration, unless the parties have a new arbitration agreement or other clear expression of intent. (c) The dispute resolution clause is an agreement by which the parties choose the method of dispute resolution based on the principle of autonomy, and in the absence of prohibitive provisions, the parties' autonomy should be respected to the greatest extent. The court of first instance erred in finding that because the parties had already chosen arbitration to resolve contract disputes, any new disputes arising during the cooperation should also be resolved by the selected arbitration method. The court of second instance should correct this.

Mingfa Company's claims at first instance were as follows: 1. To order Baolong Company to pay Mingfa Company the project expenditures of the Mingfa Commercial Plaza in the amount of RMB 166,269,681.29; 2. To order Baolong Company to pay Mingfa Company the cost of capital occupation in the amount of RMB 103,270,099.05; 3. To order Baolong Company to pay Mingfa Company the "Mingfa" brand usage fee of RMB 48,000,000 (the specific amount to be determined by expert opinion); 4. To order Baolong Company to pay Mingfa Company legal fees of RMB 500,000; 5. To order Baolong Company to bear all litigation costs of this case. On November 19, 2019, Mingfa Company added the following claims: 1. To order Baolong Company to pay property usage fees (tentatively calculated to July 15, 2019, totaling RMB 25,113,855.78) and corresponding interest on capital occupation (calculated on an annual basis at an annual interest rate of 10%, tentatively calculated to July 15, 2019, totaling RMB 16,895,238.9); 2. To order Baolong Company to pay interest on capital occupation for insufficient initial investment in the amount of RMB 1,053,811.74; 3. To order Baolong Company to pay property management fees (tentatively calculated to June 18, 2019, totaling RMB 21,917,044.78); 4. To order Baolong Company to pay salaries of senior management personnel (tentatively calculated to June 18, 2019, totaling RMB 20,653,561.64); 5. To order Baolong Company to pay Mingfa Company construction costs in the amount of RMB 23,032,176.

The court of first instance held as follows: First, the parties had already chosen to resolve contract disputes through arbitration. On November 8, 2002, Mingfa Company and Baolong Company signed the Cooperation Contract. On November 26, 2009, Baolong Company applied for arbitration with the Xiamen Arbitration Commission in accordance with Article 12 of the Cooperation Contract, which states: "Disputes arising from the execution and interpretation of the clauses of this Contract shall be resolved through friendly consultation between the cooperating parties as far as possible. If the dispute cannot be resolved through consultation, it may be submitted to the local arbitration institution for arbitration or to the people's court with jurisdiction for litigation." On December 1, 2009, Mingfa Company received the notice of acceptance and related materials from the Xiamen Arbitration Commission, appointed arbitrator Liao Yixin, and raised no objection to the Xiamen Arbitration Commission's acceptance of the case or the formation of the arbitration tribunal. Both parties participated in the arbitration proceedings until the arbitration commission rendered its award on October 30, 2018. Pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Arbitration Law of the PRC and Article 7 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Arbitration Law of the PRC, the above conduct of the parties indicates that they have chosen to resolve disputes arising from the cooperation through arbitration. Second, on October 30, 2018, the Xiamen Arbitration Commission rendered an award on the dispute between the parties based on Baolong Company's application. Subsequently, the Xiamen Intermediate People's Court also ruled to dismiss Mingfa Company's application to set aside the arbitration award. The lawsuit filed by Mingfa Company in this case (including the added claims) is still based on disputes arising from the performance of the Cooperation Contract signed on November 8, 2002. Pursuant to Article 9 of the Arbitration Law of the PRC, which provides that "arbitration shall be final and binding. After an award is rendered, if a party applies for arbitration again or files a lawsuit with a people's court concerning the same dispute, the arbitration commission or the people's court shall not accept the case," Mingfa Company cannot bring a civil lawsuit before a people's court for disputes that have already been arbitrated. For new disputes arising from the cooperation, the selected arbitration method shall still apply. In conclusion, the court of first instance, in accordance with Article 124, Item 2 and Article 154, Paragraph 1, Item 3 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, Article 9 of the Arbitration Law of the PRC, and Article 208, Paragraph 3 and Article 215 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, ruled: to dismiss the lawsuit of Mingfa Group Co., Ltd.

This Court holds as follows: Article 7 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Arbitration Law of the PRC provides: "If the parties agree that disputes may be submitted to an arbitration institution for arbitration or to a people's court for litigation, the arbitration agreement is invalid, unless one party applies for arbitration with an arbitration institution and the other party fails to raise an objection within the period specified in Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Arbitration Law." Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Arbitration Law of the PRC provides: "If a party objects to the validity of the arbitration agreement, it shall raise the objection before the first hearing of the arbitration tribunal." In this case, Article 12 of the Cooperation Contract signed by Mingfa Company and Baolong Company provides: "Disputes arising from the execution and interpretation of the clauses of this Contract shall be resolved through friendly consultation between the cooperating parties as far as possible. If the dispute cannot be resolved through consultation, it may be submitted to the local arbitration institution for arbitration or to the people's court with jurisdiction for litigation." On November 26, 2009, Baolong Company applied for arbitration with the Xiamen Arbitration Commission in accordance with this provision. Mingfa Company received the notice of acceptance and related materials from the Xiamen Arbitration Commission, raised no objection to resolving the dispute through arbitration or to the arbitration institution, and participated in the entire arbitration proceedings until the Xiamen Arbitration Commission rendered its award on October 30, 2018. The conduct of Baolong Company and Mingfa Company falls within the circumstances specified in the above laws and judicial interpretation. The agreement on the arbitration clause in Article 12 of the Cooperation Contract is legally binding on both parties. Pursuant to Article 5 of the Arbitration Law of the PRC and Article 215 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, all disputes arising from the Cooperation Contract between the parties shall be resolved through arbitration and cannot be brought to a people's court for litigation. The court of first instance did not err in ruling to dismiss Mingfa Company's lawsuit. Mingfa Company's claim that its participation in the arbitration only indicates its consent to resolve the matters involved in the requests and counterclaims in the arbitration case through arbitration and cannot be presumed to imply its consent to resolve other disputes under the contract through arbitration cannot be sustained and is not supported by this Court.

In conclusion, Mingfa Company's appeal requests cannot be sustained and shall be dismissed. In accordance with Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item 1 and Article 171 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the ruling is as follows:

Appeal dismissed; the original ruling is affirmed.

This ruling is final.

Presiding Judge: Wang Jun

Judge: Xue Guizhong

Judge: Du Weike

March 26, 2021
